description: Source code for mock proxy resolver classes used in testing the proxy resolution system within the Chromium project, including classes for asynchronous proxy resolution and factory management.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::RequestImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Request interface for handling proxy resolution requests asynchronously.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver::Job
classes.description: Represents a proxy resolution job, managing its lifecycle and completion.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver
classes.description: Mock implementation of an asynchronous proxy resolver for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory::Request
classes.description: Represents a request to create a proxy resolver, used within the factory.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory::Job
classes.description: Represents a job within the factory, managing request lifecycle.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating mock proxy resolvers for testing.

classes.name: ForwardingProxyResolver
classes.description: Proxy resolver that forwards calls to an underlying resolver implementation.

methods.name: GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Initiates proxy resolution for a given URL, returning ERR_IO_PENDING and completing asynchronously.

methods.name: AddCancelledJob
methods.description: Adds a job to the list of cancelled jobs, removing it from pending jobs.

methods.name: RemovePendingJob
methods.description: Removes a job from the list of pending jobs.

methods.name: CreateProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates a new proxy resolver instance asynchronously.

methods.name: CompleteNow
methods.description: Completes a proxy resolution request immediately with a result.

methods.name: CompleteNowWithForwarder
methods.description: Completes a request with a forwarder resolver.

methods.name: FactoryDestroyed
methods.description: Indicates that the factory has been destroyed, cleaning up references.
